title: Proving Training Data
subtitle: How training data earns its score

paper.title: DataPrep-Bench: Benchmarking LLMs as Training Data Preparators

chapters.title: Every Chunk Gets a Verdict
chapters.blurb: How section-aware chunking, explicit kept-or-skipped status, validation, and coverage auditing turn long documents into complete supervision data.

chapters.title: Make the Data Prove It
chapters.blurb: Why Data Prep Bench evaluates constructed datasets by fine-tuning under a shared protocol and measuring downstream performance across six domains.

chapters.title: Measure the Gap Between Clouds
chapters.blurb: How Distributional Alignment Score embeds candidate and proxy datasets, then uses radial-basis maximum mean discrepancy to measure their gap.

chapters.title: A Score Must Track Reality
chapters.blurb: How metric values are paired with downstream accuracies and judged by Pearson correlation, Spearman correlation, and a linear fit.
